proposal.selection: Union unchanged full-frame proposals with fixed 40-percent corner-tile proposals; no NMS, target text, target identity, target box, or truth access.

masker.contract: Apply unchanged native SAM2 once to every retained proposal.

geometry.pair_score: Geometric mean of depth-consistent proposal-mask coverage in both directions.
geometry.candidate_score: Rank depth-supported candidates first, then any mutual-best edge, maximum symmetric track score, objectness, and frozen proposal index.

literature_motivation.use: Form the initial bounded hypotheses using 3D mask association rather than correlated appearance scores.
